are_you_ok.title: Crews rush to Grafton after suspected explosion hospitalizes one
are_you_ok.summary: The accident happened Saturday night as crews rushed to Grafton, a town about 75 miles south of Wheeling, WV, after a suspected explosion hospitalized one person.
questions: Did you catch the news about the explosion in Grafton?
